$comment: Curated spec of 3rd-party CLI tools the plugin invokes. Tools with `installLatest: true` are installed at their LATEST published version by default (no pinned `recommended` to bump) — the runner stamps whatever version actually landed via the package manager. `recommended` (optional) is only a drift/stamp-fallback hint now, NOT the install target. `minimum` is the lowest version that actually works for our integration; below it the runner refuses with a clear upgrade hint. `runtime`/`runtimeMinMajor`/`runtimeMinMinor` declare the language runtime a tool needs (python >=3.10, node >=22, …); the shared runtime resolver (src/shared/runtime-resolve.ts) probes GUI-PATH-proof absolute locations (Homebrew, nvm, pyenv) for a satisfying interpreter so a stale GUI PATH can't doom the install. Probes use `versionRegex` against the CLI's `--version` (or alternate `versionCommand`) output. Keep this list lean: only tools the plugin auto-installs or auto-invokes.

gitnexus.notes: Requires Node >=22 (runtime field). Hooks install GitNexus@latest into a Traffic One-managed npm prefix; runner invokes it through an absolute Node 22 binary resolved nvm-first so PATH order doesn't matter.

graphify.installCommand: Traffic One managed pipx or venv install/upgrade (latest)
graphify.notes: Python CLI requiring Python >=3.10 (runtime field — graphifyy wheels set Requires-Python >=3.10, so a stock-macOS CLT Python 3.9.x venv yields `No matching distribution`; the runtime resolver finds a >=3.10 interpreter via Homebrew/pyenv absolute paths). The `graphifyy` package name is intentional (not a typo) — that's how it is published on PyPI. Installed at latest; Traffic One prefers `graphify --version` and retains the adjacent `pip show graphifyy` probe for compatibility with older releases. `graphify update .` exits non-zero on a project with no code files, so onboarding gates on install (not on the first scan).

opencode.notes: OpenCode CLI used to delegate bounded, low-risk coding tasks. Installed at latest into a Traffic One-managed npm prefix; do not ask users to run the upstream curl installer. Needs Node >=18 (runtime field); the install prefers PATH npm, falling back to a resolved node/npm. Delegation runs headless (`opencode run --format json`) on the free zero-auth `opencode/*` gateway chain in src/config/opencode-delegation.ts (OPENCODE_FREE_MODELS), identically on paid hosts; pin a different model per project via the `openCode.model` local preference.

gitleaks.notes: Used by `predeploy-security-check`. CI pins `gitleaks@v8.30.1`. Local installs need brew (macOS) or apt/release binary (Linux).

trufflehog.notes: Used by `predeploy-security-check`. CI pins `trufflehog@v3.94.3`. Local installs need brew (macOS) or the trufflesecurity release binary (Linux).
